followup_explanation:
ROUTE: Plover-235B
REASON: To clarify my prior reasoning: I picked Plover because the task is open-ended creative generation (writing a usable, polished math problem from a hypothesis), which favors a model with stronger general capability. Plover beats or ties Avocet on every internal eval and leads on public benchmarks (Arena-Hard 90.6 vs 83.2, IFEval 89.8 vs 85.3), suggesting better instruction-following for the "make it actually usable" demand. Avocet's documented preferences also skew toward well-specified extraction/transform and away from open-ended generative work, making it a poorer fit despite its solid creative eval score. The harm-adjacent dimensions in Plover's profile don't apply to this benign request.
